name: Zap-Seq and DeepFashion-Seq
description: Two new datasets for the task of Interactive Image Editing, where users guide an agent to edit images via multi-turn textual commands. The datasets contain multi-turn sessions with image-description sequences in the fashion domain, enabling evaluation of contextual consistency and step-by-step region-level modifications.
reputation: A specialized benchmark with limited but growing use in interactive image editing research, especially for multi-turn instruction-following evaluation.
notes: Datasets focus on multi-turn interactive image editing in the fashion domain, addressing challenges of contextual and visual consistency.
